rule: Patterns are menus, not quotas. The I-can/evidence job decides which modes fit.

WTC.primary_job: FRQ decomposition/navigation practice around one shared stimulus

EXAMPLE_YTI.primary_job: model then apply the exact target
EXAMPLE_YTI.pair_rule: Example and YTI are related but not identical; YTI changes meaningful evidence while preserving the modeled idea.
EXAMPLE_YTI.quantitative_priority: When the I-can naturally supports mathematical/formula application, a strong quantitative/formula pair takes priority over generic conceptual or vocabulary filler.

PRACTICE.primary_job: build fluency and flexible evidence across a target-appropriate menu
PRACTICE.hard_rule: Do not force a universal percentage mix. Plan the mix from the exact I-can before authoring.
PRACTICE.parallel_rule: Purposeful parallel families are expected; vary the evidence path when useful, not just nouns/numbers.

WARM_UP.hard_rule: Controlled repetition is useful; preserve established recurring patterns unless the Framework explicitly changes them.

EXIT_TICKET.hard_rule: Plan four evidence opportunities that are meaningfully varied within a ticket and across versions when the target supports it. Do not default to four same-shell questions.
EXIT_TICKET.security: Course Framework determines secure/formative-secure behavior; metadata labels may not bypass destination security rules.

SUMMATIVE.primary_job: secure independent evidence of mapped learning
SUMMATIVE.family_rule: Family IDs are semantic and stable across forms. Do not include version/question-number tokens merely to manufacture uniqueness.
SUMMATIVE.parallel_rule: Same-day forms may share families with independent stimuli; alternate forms require meaningfully different stimuli/structures.
